landing.title: See your home's energy live, and control it from anywhere
landing.sub: Monitor your inverter and lithium battery, get alerts on Telegram and ask the AI assistant in plain language. Built for homeowners and installers.
landing.features_title: Everything you need to know what your system is doing
landing.f_live_d: Panels, grid, battery and home in an animated diagram refreshed every 15 seconds.
landing.f_alerts_d: Low battery, grid loss, overload or fault: on Telegram and email.
landing.f_control_d: Change output priority and charge current with confirmation, safe limits and a full audit log.
landing.f_ai_d: Ask: how long will the battery last tonight? When should I run the washing machine?
landing.f_auto_d: Switch off the heater automatically when the battery runs low, and bring it back when it recovers.
landing.f_api_d: Connect your data to any system, or straight to Claude.
landing.final_sub: Create a free account and add a device in minutes, or try the demo device first.

control.title: Inverter settings
control.sub: Every change needs confirmation and is logged under your name.
control.viewer_note: You have view-only access. Owner or admin role is required to change settings.
control.safe_range: Safe range for your battery: {min} to {max} {unit}. Values outside it are rejected.
control.out_of_range: Value is outside the safe range

alerts.title: Alerts and rules
alerts.empty_text: When something needs your attention it will show up here.
alerts.rules_sub: Choose what alerts you, when, and on which channel. The cooldown prevents the same alert from repeating.
alerts.desc_battery_low: When the battery level drops below the threshold.
alerts.desc_battery_full: When the battery reaches the set level.
alerts.desc_overload: When load exceeds a share of inverter capacity for a set time.
alerts.desc_fault: When the inverter enters fault mode or reports a fault code.
alerts.desc_device_offline: When no readings arrive from the device.
alerts.desc_high_temperature: When inverter temperature exceeds the limit.
alerts.desc_daily_summary: A daily summary of production and consumption.

auto.title: Automatic load shedding
auto.sub: When conditions are met, run the actions; when things recover, restore everything.
auto.empty_text: Example: when the battery drops below 30% and the grid is out, switch off the heater via a smart relay and notify me.
auto.name: Rule name
auto.recover_hint: Optional. Runs once when the rule leaves the active state.
auto.http_hint: The request is sent from our server to the relay address, so it must be reachable from the internet (or via a tunnel).
auto.tpl_name: Switch off heater on low battery
auto.tpl_notify: Battery low and grid out: heater switched off
auto.tpl_recover: Battery recovered: heater switched back on

assistant.title: Ask about your system
assistant.sub: Reads your device's status and history and answers in your language.
assistant.welcome: Ask me about solar production, battery health or the best time to run heavy appliances.
assistant.chip_washer: When should I run the washing machine?
assistant.chip_tonight: How long will the battery last tonight?
assistant.unavailable_msg: The assistant is unavailable right now because the service isn't configured on the server yet. Try again later or contact support.
assistant.unavailable_banner: The assistant service isn't enabled on this server. Everything else works normally.
assistant.error: Couldn't get an answer. Please try again.
